tasks.title: TDD: Run command — core loop
tasks.description:
Add the main run command orchestration to src/commands/run.ts and test/commands/run.test.ts.

Implement:
- runRun(opts: { maxIterations?: number, projectRoot: string, dataDir: string, config: RalphConfig, agents: AgentInfo[] }): Promise<void>

Port the main loop from ralph_execute.sh (lines 269-737) and the 'no tasks.json' UX from ralph_loop.sh.

Behavior:
1. Check for tasks.json — if missing, prompt 'No tasks.json found. Launch planner?' (preserve UX from ralph_loop.sh). If yes, call runPlan() from plan.ts.
2. PATH augmentation: prepend ~/.bun/bin, ~/.cargo/bin, /opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin to process.env.PATH
3. Initialize ProcessManager, register signal handlers
4. Main iteration loop (up to maxIterations, default 30):
   a. Check for .ralph_complete flag → break if found
   b. Load completed IDs via loadCompletedIds()
   c. Select next task via selectNextTask() → break if null
   d. Run health check via runHealthCheck() → prepend failure output to prompt if failed
   e. Build iteration prompt via buildIterationPrompt()
   f. Build system prompt via buildSystemPrompt()
   g. Spawn Claude via spawnClaude()
   h. Post-iteration: validate tests via validateTaskTests()
   i. Archive completed tasks via archiveCompletedTasks()
   j. Carry forward prevNotes for next iteration
5. Clean up temp files (.ralph_complete, .ralph_prev_notes, .ralph_completed_ids)

Compose all previously built modules. Make dependencies injectable for testing.
tasks.notes: Implemented runRun() with full dependency injection via RunRunDeps interface (22 new tests, 64 total in file). All modules composed: task selection, health check, prompt building, Claude spawning, test validation, archival, and prevNotes threading. Agent model override logic ported. PATH augmentation, ProcessManager lifecycle, temp file cleanup, and RALPH_TASK_CONTEXT env all covered. Task #11 will add narration lifecycle and final summary.

tasks.title: TDD: Run command — narration + summary
tasks.description:
Add narration server lifecycle management and final summary to the run command in src/commands/run.ts and test/commands/run.test.ts.

Narration lifecycle within the loop:
- If config.narration.enabled: start narration server before first iteration using startNarrationServer()
- Health check the narration server each iteration via checkNarrationHealth() — auto-restart if dead
- Pass narrate callback to processStream options so tool results get narrated
- Stop narration server on loop exit (normal or signal) via stopNarrationServer()
- Register narration server PID with ProcessManager for signal cleanup

Iteration logging:
- Log iteration number, task being worked on, start/end times to .ralph_iterations.log
- Format: timestamp + iteration number + task id + task title

Final summary:
- Print total iterations completed, tasks completed/remaining counts
- If config.narration.ntfyTopic set, send ntfy notification via sendNtfy() from stream-filter.ts with completion summary
- Narrate the final summary if narration is enabled

tasks.title: Verify bun build --compile with run + narrate
tasks.description:
Verify that the compiled binary includes and correctly dispatches the new run and narrate commands.

Steps:
1. Run 'bun build --compile src/index.ts --outfile dist/ralph' (the existing build script)
2. Test the binary: dist/ralph --version, dist/ralph --help
3. Verify 'dist/ralph run --help' shows the run command with [max] argument
4. Verify 'dist/ralph narrate --help' shows the narrate command with <action> argument
5. Verify that no shell fallback commands remain (SHELL_FALLBACK_COMMANDS should be empty)
6. Run the full test suite: bun test
7. If any issues found, fix them and re-verify

This is a validation task — the goal is to catch any compilation or runtime issues before the phase is considered complete.
